photos.title: Skyland sample outcrop after drilling
photos.associationReason: NASA sample catalogue explicitly names Skyland, its parent feature, and this linked image; association does not rely on rover proximity.
photos.caption: Image taken was taken by the Mars Perseverance rover after collecting the rock sample 11 at Skyland. Sample 10 and 11 drill hole with an abrasion patch.
limitations: NASA web PNG asset, not independently cross-matched to a native PDS camera product.
